spec.description: Docker resources, health, lifecycle and exporter status for cadvisor-rs. MIT License; Copyright (c) 2025 Primexz. Optional metrics are not zero-filled.

spec.title: Memory working set · top 10
spec.description: Working set for the ten largest matching containers at each instant. RSS and file-cache breakdowns are below.

spec.title: Container inventory
spec.description: Current Docker inventory, including stopped containers. No HEALTHCHECK is shown as none, never healthy. Dynamic state disappears after a failed Docker refresh.

spec.expr: max by (job, instance, name, image, state, status) (container_state{job="${job}",instance=~"${instance}",name=~"${container}",image!=""} * on (job, instance, id) group_left (status) container_health_status{job="${job}",instance=~"${instance}",name=~"${container}",image!=""})

spec.title: Health check history
spec.description: Sampled Docker health at the metadata refresh cadence. No check and unknown remain distinct; missing observations leave gaps.

spec.expr: max by (job, instance, name) (container_health_status{job="${job}",instance=~"${instance}",name=~"${container}",image!="",status="healthy"} or (2 * container_health_status{job="${job}",instance=~"${instance}",name=~"${container}",image!="",status="unhealthy"}) or (3 * container_health_status{job="${job}",instance=~"${instance}",name=~"${container}",image!="",status="starting"}) or (0 * container_health_status{job="${job}",instance=~"${instance}",name=~"${container}",image!="",status="none"}) or (4 * container_health_status{job="${job}",instance=~"${instance}",name=~"${container}",image!="",status="unknown"}))

spec.title: Restarts · selected range
spec.description: Ten largest automatic restart increases in the selected time range. Values can be fractional due to Prometheus extrapolation.

spec.title: CPU quota utilization
spec.description: Usage divided by the configured CPU quota in cores. Unlimited containers are omitted; this is not host CPU utilization.

spec.expr: 100 * max by (job, instance, name) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="${job}",instance=~"${instance}",name=~"${container}",image!="",cpu="total"}[$__rate_interval])) / (max by (job, instance, name) (container_spec_cpu_limit_cores{job="${job}",instance=~"${instance}",name=~"${container}",image!=""}) > 0)

spec.title: CFS periods throttled
spec.description: Fraction of elapsed CFS periods with any throttling. This is a period ratio, not the percentage of CPU time lost. Zero denominators are omitted.

spec.expr: 100 * max by (job, instance, name) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{job="${job}",instance=~"${instance}",name=~"${container}",image!=""}[$__rate_interval])) / (max by (job, instance, name) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{job="${job}",instance=~"${instance}",name=~"${container}",image!=""}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

spec.title: Memory limit utilization
spec.description: Working set divided by the reported memory limit. Unlimited memory uses host capacity when known.

spec.expr: 100 * max by (job, instance, name) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="${job}",instance=~"${instance}",name=~"${container}",image!=""}) / (max by (job, instance, name) (container_spec_memory_limit_bytes{job="${job}",instance=~"${instance}",name=~"${container}",image!=""}) > 0)

spec.title: Memory composition
spec.description: Separate RSS, file cache and swap observations. Curves are not stacked because they are not interchangeable with working set.

spec.title: OOM kills · selected range
spec.description: OOM kill counter increases, when exposed by the kernel. Unsupported counters remain N/A; no synthetic zero is supplied.

spec.title: Network throughput
spec.description: Bytes/second summed over interfaces. Shared network namespaces can repeat the same counters across containers; do not sum these into host traffic. Nested observations are deduplicated per container and interface before summing.

spec.expr: sum by (job, instance, name) (max by (job, instance, name, interface) (rate(container_network_receive_bytes_total{job="${job}",instance=~"${instance}",name=~"${container}",image!=""}[$__rate_interval])))

sum by (job, instance, name) (max by (job, instance, name, interface) (rate(container_network_transmit_bytes_total{job="${job}",instance=~"${instance}",name=~"${container}",image!=""}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: Block I/O throughput
spec.description: Kernel cgroup read/write bytes/second summed over block devices. Device capacity and writable-layer sizes are separate observations. Nested observations are deduplicated per container and device before summing.

spec.expr: sum by (job, instance, name) (max by (job, instance, name, device) (rate(container_fs_reads_bytes_total{job="${job}",instance=~"${instance}",name=~"${container}",image!=""}[$__rate_interval])))
sum by (job, instance, name) (max by (job, instance, name, device) (rate(container_fs_writes_bytes_total{job="${job}",instance=~"${instance}",name=~"${container}",image!=""}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: Established TCP connections
spec.description: Current established socket counts. The legacy _total families are gauges; no rate is applied.

spec.title: Network errors & packet drops
spec.description: Interface errors and dropped packets per second. These are not TCP retransmission metrics. Nested observations are deduplicated per container and interface before summing.

spec.expr: sum by (job, instance, name) (max by (job, instance, name, interface) (rate(container_network_receive_errors_total{job="${job}",instance=~"${instance}",name=~"${container}",image!=""}[$__rate_interval])))

sum by (job, instance, name) (max by (job, instance, name, interface) (rate(container_network_transmit_errors_total{job="${job}",instance=~"${instance}",name=~"${container}",image!=""}[$__rate_interval])))

sum by (job, instance, name) (max by (job, instance, name, interface) (rate(container_network_receive_packets_dropped_total{job="${job}",instance=~"${instance}",name=~"${container}",image!=""}[$__rate_interval])))

sum by (job, instance, name) (max by (job, instance, name, interface) (rate(container_network_transmit_packets_dropped_total{job="${job}",instance=~"${instance}",name=~"${container}",image!=""}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: Processes, threads & open descriptors
spec.description: Bounded procfs observations. Missing permissions or incomplete reads omit partial sums. FD counts cover all processes, not just the init process.

spec.title: Pressure stalls · 10-second averages
spec.description: Native PSI percentages, already in the 0–100 range. CPU is some/waiting; memory and I/O are full/stalled. Requires cgroup v2 and kernel PSI.

spec.title: Filesystem available space
spec.description: Available capacity of each shared backing filesystem, not per-container disk usage. device=rootfs or a mount destination. Requires readable /proc/PID/root.

spec.expr: 100 * max by (job, instance, name, device) (container_fs_available_bytes{job="${job}",instance=~"${instance}",name=~"${container}",image!=""}) / (max by (job, instance, name, device) (container_fs_limit_bytes{job="${job}",instance=~"${instance}",name=~"${container}",image!=""}) > 0)

spec.title: Running containers
spec.description: Docker running state, including paused containers. Deduplicated per job/host/container name.

spec.title: Writable layers · top 10
spec.description: Opt-in Docker SizeRw; enable --docker-size-metrics. Does not include image layers or attribute volume contents. Empty by default is expected.

spec.title: Docker daemon inventory
spec.description: Daemon-wide running/paused/stopped counts. Follows job and host selection, independently of the container filter.

spec.title: Exporter snapshot age
spec.description: Seconds since the current cgroup snapshot. Normally near the collection interval; compare with Prometheus target health when samples stop arriving.

spec.title: Collection & Docker availability
spec.description: 1=available, 0=failed. Docker collectors report zero if deliberately disabled. Prometheus up remains useful when the exporter cannot be scraped.

spec.title: Optional collection errors
spec.description: Number of selected containers with optional read errors, deduplicated by host and name. These queries follow the container filter; optional errors do not fail core readiness.

spec.title: Cgroup collection duration
spec.description: Filesystem sampling duration, excluding Docker enrichment and HTTP encoding. This is not total scrape latency.

spec.title: Docker inspect failures
spec.description: Failed or deadline-skipped inspect observations. Default concurrency is eight with a five-second total inspect budget. Zero also applies when inspect is disabled; this gauge alone does not confirm inspection is enabled.

spec.title: Stopped containers
spec.description: Inventory entries Docker reports not running, including created/exited containers. No data if Docker inventory is unavailable.

spec.title: Failing health checks
spec.description: Unhealthy Docker HEALTHCHECK results. Zero is returned only while health observations exist. No check configured is not a passing check; see the status table/timeline.

spec.expr: sum(max by (job, instance, name) (container_health_status{job="${job}",instance=~"${instance}",name=~"${container}",image!="",status="unhealthy"})) or (0 * count(max by (job, instance, name) (container_health_status{job="${job}",instance=~"${instance}",name=~"${container}",image!=""})))

spec.title: Restarts · selected range
spec.description: Estimated automatic Docker restarts over the selected dashboard range. The Docker counter can reset on manual start; Prometheus increase handles resets.

spec.title: CPU · logical cores
spec.description: One core means 100% of one logical CPU. Total usage of the selected containers; no host or child-cgroup double counting.

spec.title: Memory · working set
spec.description: Charged memory minus inactive file cache, saturated at zero.

spec.title: CPU usage · top 10
spec.description: Percent of one logical core, so multi-core workloads may exceed 100%. The ten largest matching series at each instant.

spec.title: cadvisor-rs · Container overview
